title: Final public pre-release readiness gate

context.summary: Add the final public-ready pre-release acceptance gate.
context.background: TASK-118 through TASK-131 established current public docs, release bootstrap, live self-host acceptance, local model acceptance and Web UI E2E acceptance. The final task ties those checks into a single release announcement gate with CI-safe dry-run validation and opt-in live execution from a fresh clone.

in: Add a root public-ready:gate command with dry-run checklist validation.

Add live orchestration for fresh clone, pnpm check, published-release bootstrap acceptance, self-host live gate, local-model live acceptance, Web UI live E2E, public wording validation and clean git status.
Update README, MVP acceptance, deployment, release checklist, support matrix, repository status, PRD, development process and changelog docs.
out: Running the live final gate automatically during pnpm check.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm public-ready:gate passes in dry-run mode and is included in pnpm check.
Live mode performs a real fresh clone and delegates to the existing live release, self-host, local-model and Web UI acceptance commands.
The gate checks public stale wording validation and clean git status before reporting success.
Public docs describe the final pre-release gate and its live environment variables.
Task registry marks TASK-132 as current and done.

manual_checks: Confirm live mode is opt-in through MINDORY_PUBLIC_READY_LIVE=true.
Confirm dry-run mode does not start Docker or download release artifacts.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
